name: Sibanye Stillwater Limited
content: Sibanye-Stillwater is a multinational mining and metals processing group with a diverse portfolio of operations, projects, and investments across five continents. The company is one of the world's largest primary producers of platinum, palladium, and rhodium and is a top-tier gold producer. It has also diversified into the battery metals sector, investing in lithium, nickel, and copper projects. Sibanye-Stillwater is committed to delivering value to all stakeholders while contributing to a sustainable future through the responsible production of metals essential for a low-carbon economy.

Officers

Neal FronemanJanuary 2013

Chief Executive Officer

Neal Froneman was appointed executive director and CEO of Sibanye-Stillwater on 1 January 2013. He has over 40 years of experience in the mining industry. Prior to joining Sibanye-Stillwater, he was CEO of Gold One International Limited and Aflease Gold Limited.

Charl KeyterJanuary 2013

Chief Financial Officer

Charl Keyter was appointed executive director and CFO of Sibanye-Stillwater on 1 January 2013. He has over 25 years of experience in the mining industry and previously held various senior financial roles at Gold Fields Limited.
